question: Find the paper that grows the perovskite film with the assistance of a PC71BM layer spin-coated on the precursor film. Give its DOI and the PCE of the devices made by this simplified method and of those made by the conventional one-step method.
final_answer: The paper that grows the perovskite film with the assistance of a PC71BM layer spin-coated on the precursor film has the DOI 10.1007/s10118-017-1891-z. According to the paper, the devices made by the simplified method (where PC71BM is dropped during spin-coating or sequentially spin-coated to form the film at the same time) achieved a PCE of 16.03% (or up to 16.82% depending on the specific optimization conditions described in the text), whereas the conventional one-step method devices achieved a PCE of 13.06% (or 14.53% for the conventional anti-solvent dripping method).
